name: cv-for-role
description: Comprehensive resume tailoring assistant plugin: generates ATS-ready resume, cover letter, interview Q&A, scoring dashboard, and video resume script for applicants.

skills.name: generate-resume
skills.description: Generates a role-tailored, ATS-friendly resume in Markdown for an applicant based on their profile and job description.

skills.name: generate-cover-letter
skills.description: Generates a cover letter with selectable tone for an applicant and target role.

skills.name: generate-interview-qa
skills.description: Generates interview Q&A with multi-round follow-up prompts for a given role.

skills.name: generate-scoring-dashboard
skills.description: Generates a dashboard with Match %, ATS %, Gap score, and improvement suggestions.

skills.name: generate-video-resume-script
skills.description: Generates a 2-minute video resume script for an applicant.
